scientific_integrity: The global optimization is established by exact angular covering and equality analysis. A standalone numerical checker corroborates but does not prove statements about continuously varying weights and phases. No independent publication-priority certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact theorem for the five-cycle, rank-one full Gabor matrix lifting and exactly three supported complex entries only. It does not optimize nonlinear phase-retrieval Lipschitz constants or higher-order cyclic designs. The 2026 preprint was inspected in abstract only; a differently presented prior calculation cannot be ruled out. Independent scientific audit is not performed.
title: Sharp stability of three-site Gabor tomography on the five-cycle
